ownership.owns: The scikitplot.impute public re-export/experimental gate, ANNImputer imputation semantics, backend selection policy, approximate-neighbor weighting/fallback behavior, index visibility/persistence policy, and impute-local compatibility code/tests.
ownership.does_not_own: Annoy native/Cython implementation, Voyager implementation, generic path/timing utilities, scikitplot root package wiring, sklearn imputer semantics, or experimental namespace infrastructure outside the impute activation hook.

public.description: Stable sklearn re-exports plus fail-closed experimental ANNImputer access.

ann.description: ANNImputer estimator, backend dispatch, fit/transform, metric/weighting and persistence integration.

privacy.description: Index visibility and external storage policy; explicitly not a security boundary.

compatibility_mirror.description: Sklearn-derived imputer implementation whose active ownership/use must remain explicit; currently not on the ANN/public path.
